lane: co-training between a geophysical view and a surface view, disagreement as the discovery signal (Blum & Mitchell COLT '98, doi:10.1145/279943.279962)
hypothesis_document_renamed_from: knowledge/25_hypotheses_H60_preregistered.md (renamed to H60D when a parallel H60 session, later branded H60C, merged first and occupied the plain h60 file names)

evaluator_version.metric: gems52.metric.dti (alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, R 300 m triangular kernel, lattice-exact offsets)
evaluator_version.holdout: gems52.holdout.make_folds(mode=hide, n_folds=4, buffer_px=4, prevalence=0.002, seed=20261009); mask_visible pixel-exact; tip mode secondary
evaluator_version.pooling: per-fold DTI plus pooled DTI (TPw/FPw/FNw/n_truth component sums pooled across folds); fold-bootstrap 95% CI (10k resamples)

data_integrity.required_action: Verify every input against the manifest SHA-256 pins before any read; fail closed on mismatch; record the tracked data/*.tif stubs' measured hashes and their inequality to the pins; never overwrite data/*.tif.
data_integrity.qualification: Owner-supplied GitHub mirrors verified by hash and byte count; proves mirror integrity, NOT organizer authentication.

protocol.feature_stack: gems52.h57.build_layers default spec (16 training_features bands + 9 external bands, val/grad/range = 75 uint8 rank layers), cached at work/h60/layers.u8; REUSED, not rebuilt

views.A: h57.VIEW_A_LAYERS (potential-field/subsurface: gravity 5/11/13/18, magnetics 1/2/3/9/14, strain 4, seismicity 16, depth 15, conductivity 17)
views.B: h57.VIEW_B_LAYERS (surface: radiometric TC 6, det_elev 12, det_elev_slope 19, external LiDAR scarp + GeoDAWN radiometric/ratio bands)

protocol.oof_folds: holdout.make_folds(mode='hide', n_folds=4, buffer_px=4, prevalence=0.002, seed=20261009); fit per fold on fold['fit'] (held segments + buffer excluded); OOF field = model prediction inside fold['region']
protocol.emitter_validation: h57.iso_select isotropic 3 px (anisotropic refuted H57); final artifact placement: gems52.emit.greedy_emit R=3 triangular kernel, dti_projected=0 (fixed matched budget)
protocol.pool: fold region & footprint & ~dilate(catalogue, 2 px) [the <=200 m ring rule]

fields.cotreatment: H60-3: one co-training round, both directions, whole-segment pseudo-labels (confident donor -> abstaining receiver, one 50x50 block per segment, never on catalogue/corridor/boundary pixels), fold-0 fit region; arms pA1/pB1 vs round-0 pa/pb

decision_rules.leakage_canary: every cached layer alone vs holdout truth (tie-aware AUC per fold region); AUC > 0.90 on any layer = leakage: stop and report, no result built on that layer is trusted
decision_rules.independence: spatial.independence on 50 px block OOF negative-error rows (Pearson+Spearman on block MSE and FPR) plus pixel-level; abandonment at max|r| >= 0.60; degenerate/under-powered fails closed (allow_exchange=false)
decision_rules.promotion: a disagreement field promotes iff at budget 37654 its hide fold-mean DTI exceeds the fold-mean of clf_union AND view_A AND view_B, it wins >=3/4 folds against each, and mean lift vs matched random >= +0.005 on BOTH hide and tip; otherwise ship the best measured disagreement field with verdict negative
decision_rules.artifact: pure disagreement arm, NO credited core; greedy_emit placement; legal pool = footprint & ~200 m catalogue ring & outside all accessible prior support; values exactly {0,1} float32; all finite; EPSG:32611; 3730x3292; pinned transform
decision_rules.lane_drift_gate: Spearman rank correlation of the ranking surface with EVERY registry raster <= 0.90, checked before placement AND on the final dots; fraction of final dots within 3 px of any ONE registry raster's dots <= 70%; exceeding either = duplicate lane: log and stop
decision_rules.uniqueness: gates.uniqueness_report vs every accessible aligned prior (decoded pattern distinct; >=20% support novelty; not a literal prior union)
decision_rules.not_merely_union: emission is not the top-k of max(pa,pb) under identical pool/emitter; not equal to any prior; not any pair-union of priors
decision_rules.ring: no emitted pixel within 200 m of a mapped catalogue pixel
decision_rules.reasoning: one written geological reasoning row per emitted pixel + one dossier row per A-only candidate segment in the legal pool

reporting.number_labels: every holdout number labelled HOLDOUT-DTI (evaluator version, withheld positives, 95% CI); leaderboard numbers are owner-reported, none organizer-confirmed; a projection is never written as a score
prohibitions: No leaderboard score enters any fit, field, fold, or arm; revealed-preference arithmetic sizes budgets/projections only and is labelled conditional
No number is a leaderboard forecast; Spearman(reported, simulated DTI) = -0.1045 (knowledge/10 s5)
A-only reasoning rows are hypotheses for Phase-2 review, never 'discovered faults'
Do not pick submissions: promotion to a real slot is a separate selector step, within the weekly cap on the submission page

registered_corrections.summary: E3 artifact placement changed from gems52.emit.greedy_emit to the registered scoring emitter h57.iso_select (top-k, min_px 3.0 inclusive, nms_px 5, budget 37654): the round's own placement diagnostic showed the greedy coverage surrogate selects the field's broad-plateau mass on the required-novel pool, which is anti-correlated with the holdout truth (hide pooled 2.6e-05 vs matched novel-pool random 1.24e-03), so a greedy-placed raster would not externalize the measured field. greedy_emit is retained as a disclosed, scored diagnostic. No gate outcome changes; verdict stays negative.
evidence: evidence/h60_build.json (placement diagnostic: greedy vs iso on the same pool)

registered_corrections.summary: The lane-drift 3-px proximity component excludes calibration rasters (registry/data_manifest.json ids calib_* / inputs/calibration/* — owner-supplied metric-calibration inputs such as the dense regular 5-px lattice whose 3-px dilation covers about half the grid, so any pool placement reads 70-84% against it by geometry, not duplication). Raw readings still reported; both Spearman components apply to every prior. Gate value becomes the max over the 49 non-calibration priors (0.1598, bar 0.70). No verdict changes.
